SIDDHI RAVINDRA BAVKAR

+91 9326187715 • siddhibavkar9326@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/siddhibavkar3009 • Mumbai, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Detail-oriented Finance Operations professional with 2+ years of experience in Equity Operations, Trade Lifecycle Management, and Capital Markets across Nomura and Eviden (Atos Syntel / FIS). Skilled in OTC & Listed Derivatives Settlements, Cash & Position Reconciliation, and resolving trade breaks across Equities, Fixed Income, Repos, and FX. Proven track record of improving operational efficiency, reducing settlement failures, and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Analyst – Trade Expense Team | Nomura	July 2025 – March 2026

Full-Time | Listed Derivatives | OTC Equity Derivatives | Repos | US Treasuries

Managed end-to-end settlement for 100+ daily trades across Listed Derivatives, OTC US Equity Derivatives, Repos, and US Treasuries.

Performed daily trade confirmation matching and validation against broker confirms, exchange data, and internal systems —

reducing settlement discrepancies.

Led break investigation and resolution with Front Office, Middle Office, brokers, and custodians, ensuring timely and seamless trade flow.

Executed financial reconciliations across invoice data, operational systems, and the general ledger, maintaining data integrity for audit-ready reporting.

Reviewed and processed amendment invoices and credit adjustments, supporting accurate expense allocation and financial control.

Managed month-end close activities including expense booking, accrual validation, and YTD MIS report preparation — ensuring zero discrepancies.

Ensured strict compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements, proactively minimizing counterparty exposure and operational risk.

KPO Associate | Eviden (Atos Syntel / FIS)	January 2024 – June 2025

Full-Time | Equity Operations | Reconciliation | Multi-Asset Class Settlements

Performed cash, trade, and position reconciliations between custody and investment manager books for global clients including Deutsche Bank and Chevy Bank — resolving 95%+ of breaks within SLA.

Managed trade confirmations and affirmations across Equities, Derivatives, FX, and Fixed Income, ensuring accurate and timely processing across multiple client accounts.

Handled equity pre-matching, verifying trade details (ISIN, settlement dates, quantity) to ensure compliance with T+2 settlement cycles.

Coordinated with brokers, custodians, and counterparties to resolve unmatched trades and minimize settlement risk across global portfolios.

Prepared daily MIS and risk reports for compliance and audit purposes across multiple client accounts.

Tracked and resolved operational issues using Jira, maintaining complete audit trails and documentation compliance.

Managed corporate actions impact on derivatives (F&O), including dividend adjustments and contract rollovers.

Reconciled portfolio data across Private Equity and Hedge Fund vehicles, cross-verifying positions against custodian and prime broker records to ensure accuracy prior to NAV finalization.

Prepared and delivered periodic NAV reports to internal and external stakeholders, translating fund performance data into structured summaries to support investment decision-making.

KEY SKILLS

Asset Classes: Equities | OTC Derivatives | Listed Derivatives | Fixed Income (Repos, US Treasuries) | F&O | Bonds | FX

Operations: Trade Lifecycle Management (Front to Back) | OTC Settlement | Break Resolution | Trade Confirmation & Affirmation | Cash & Position Reconciliation | Month-End Close | Accruals | MIS Reporting | Risk & Compliance

Systems & Tools: Bloomberg Terminal | Jira | Microsoft Excel (Advanced) | MS Office Suite

Soft Skills: Attention to Detail | Risk Control | Cross-functional Collaboration | Audit Documentation | Time Management



EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce – Banking & Insurance	2020 – 2023

Dalmia Lions College of Commerce & Economics, Mumbai

Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC)	2018 – 2020

Dalmia Lions College, Mumbai

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Investment Banking Operations Professional (CIBOP)	2023

Imarticus Learning

AWARDS & RECOGNITION

Bronze Award | Eviden	Awarded twice (November 2024 & January 2025) Recognised for outstanding performance, quality of work, and commitment to operational excellence.
